missions.title: Ground Truth
missions.briefing: Moreau here, Earth Mission Control. The orbital pictures only tell us so much. Put your rovers on the ground and give us ground truth: sixty tiles surveyed, and at least three different resources confirmed.

objectives.hint: Send the rovers out: every tile they drive past is surveyed.

missions.debrief: Good data, all of it. Earth has its first ground-truth map of this world. Stand by: we have something else for you.

missions.title: The Lost Pathfinder
missions.briefing: Before anyone built warp engines, Earth sent the uncrewed Pathfinder IV probe out here. It came down on this world decades ago and went silent. Its last fix puts it inside the marked search area. Find the wreck and recover the data recorder.

objectives.text: Find the Pathfinder IV wreck in the search area
objectives.hint: Drive a rover into the marked area: the wreck shows once its tile is surveyed.

message.text: Reyes: That's it, Pathfinder IV, {wreck.distance} tiles out. Park a rover beside it and we'll pull the recorder.

objectives.text: Park a rover beside the wreck
objectives.hint: Keep it parked there while the crew pull the recorder.

missions.debrief: The recorder survived. Forty years of surface readings, and the probe's own map of the ground round {wreck}. Earth will want every byte of it.

missions.title: Calling Home
missions.briefing: The recorder's data has to come home, and the outpost's antenna can't reach Earth on its own. Deploy a relay satellite whose coverage includes the base, then bring the Pathfinder wreck under coverage too, with the same relay or another.

objectives.text: Deploy a relay satellite covering the base
objectives.hint: Helm: RELAY, then pick a tile over the outpost.

objectives.text: Bring the Pathfinder wreck under relay coverage

missions.debrief: Link confirmed. Earth is reading Pathfinder IV's recorder as we speak, and the outpost has a voice of its own now.

missions.title: Wings
missions.briefing: Okafor here. The rovers can't cross half of what's out there. We can build scout drones from parts: a Machine Shop to make them, a Drone Pad to fly them from. Two drones to start.

objectives.hint: Machine Shop: order Scout Drones (frame, power coupling, control modules).

missions.debrief: Two drones on the pad and charging. Mind the batteries and keep them inside comms coverage.

missions.title: First Flight
missions.briefing: Reyes here. I want pictures of the ground the rovers can't reach. Launch a drone, then fly one to each of the three photo points beyond the ridges and the water.

objectives.text: Launch a scout drone from the Drone Pad

message.text: Reyes: Photo points marked. Out of comms range? A relay satellite over them fixes that.

objectives.text: Fly a drone to each photo point
objectives.hint: A drone loitering over a point takes its pictures.

missions.debrief: Beautiful pictures. Three valleys nobody has ever seen, on file.

missions.title: Beyond the Ridge
missions.briefing: Something out there is transmitting. It's faint and it isn't ours. Take bearings from two of the three marked points with a drone and we can narrow it down, then send a rover to it.

objectives.text: Take a bearing from 2 of the 3 points (a drone loitering)

message.text: Reyes: Got a fix. The source is somewhere in the marked area.

objectives.text: Reach the signal source with a rover

missions.debrief: A small transmitter, half sunk in the rock, still running on something we don't understand. It's not human. Not anything we know.

missions.title: Foothold
missions.briefing: One outpost is a landing. Two is a colony. Found a second outpost, by construction rover or by an outpost drop, somewhere our comms reach.

objectives.text: Found a second outpost inside comms coverage
objectives.hint: A relay satellite over the site first, then a construction rover or an outpost drop.

missions.debrief: Moreau: Two outposts, a link home, drones in the air and a signal nobody can explain. That's the end of the beginning. Well done, all of you. First Light is complete.
